reasons.swing-fist-think-later-red: Cheapest repeatable random-discard attack with built-in go again, so it both triggers Kayo's Might and keeps the chain going.
reasons.swing-fist-think-later-yellow: Same random-discard-to-attack engine at yellow, giving you a resource that still feeds every 6+ discard payoff.
reasons.swing-fist-think-later-blue: Blue version pitches for the claw's {r}{r} while still discarding a random card to trigger Might and 6+ payoffs.
reasons.breakneck-battery-red: Additional-cost random discard turns on Kayo's Might and, when it hits a 6+, the go again makes it free value.
reasons.breakneck-battery-yellow: Same discard-then-go-again pattern, and yellow gives you the resource needed to pay for Mandible Claw turns.
reasons.breakneck-battery-blue: Pitchable source of a random discard plus go again whenever the 6+ trigger lands.
reasons.madcap-charger-red: Another random-discard attack that converts a 6+ discard straight into go again, the core loop of this deck.
reasons.madcap-charger-yellow: Continues the discard-and-extend plan while also being a pitchable yellow for the claw.
reasons.madcap-charger-blue: Densest way to keep random discards flowing from the resource base.
reasons.visit-the-boneyard-blue: Puts a 6+ power card back on top of your deck, which Headstrong Stampede/Buckwild then see and which your random discards can hit again.
